senses.gloss: f. (διαθήκη) a disposition of property, esp. by will and testament; covenant, contract, v.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 3:7:14">Y. Peah III, 17ᵈ</cite> bot. for difference between <he>ד׳</he> a. <he>מתנה</he>.—

<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 24:10">Targ. Y. Gen. XXIV, 10</cite> <he>ד׳ דריבונא</he> Ar. (ed. <he>שפר אפותיקי</he>); <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 59:11">Gen. R. s. 59</cite>, end (ref. to Gen. l. c.) <he>זו ד׳</he> this means (his master’s) will (in favor of Isaac).—Y. Ber. V, 9ᵇ top <he>בד׳ נתתיו לו וכ׳</he> have I given it to him as a bequest (which may be cancelled)? I have given it to him as a donation.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 8:7:4">Y. B. Bath. VIII, 16ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ויחזור בדְיָיתִיקָתוֹ</he> he may change his will.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 152b:4">B. Bath. 152ᵇ</cite> <he>ד׳ מבטלת ד׳</he> the later will cancels the prior. Y. B. Mets. I, end, 8ᵃ <he>אין … לפגם דייתיקין וכ׳</he> nobody is likely to make a defective will (by anticipating in it the receipt of a debt before it has been collected).—Pl. <he>דְּיָיתִיקָאוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 11:6">Tosef. B. Bath. XI, 6</cite>; a. e.
